name: tineapp
description: 世界构建辅助工具 — visualize characters and events on interactive timelines with relationship graphs for large-scale worldview design

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron ."
scripts.electron:prebuild: vite build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/prebuild.cjs
scripts.electron:build: npm run electron:prebuild && set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false && npx electron-builder --win nsis --config.electronDist=release/electron-dist
